title: MDPF_CANON CN-b-3 + CN-b-4: the publisher to python3.11 + pandas-pyarrow-requests-layer with one DELTA=0 ad-hoc run, and the composite grant re-pointed to builder output (no-op plan)
author: 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~DELL1

legs.target: CN-b-4: the targeted plan on aws_iam_role_policy.mdpf_gold_writers in infra/aws/terraform/mdpf-pipeline, which must show the rendered policy UNCHANGED and is never applied otherwise
legs.proof_required: C2: 'No changes', or a change whose rendered policy JSON is byte-identical before and after -- compared as parsed JSON, not as a diff of the HCL

legs.target: the publisher's live configuration after the apply
legs.proof_required: C3: Runtime python3.11, Layers naming pandas-pyarrow-requests-layer, and GOLD_BUCKET / GOLD_ROOT / SERVE_BUCKET / SERVE_ROOT each byte-equal to its pre-apply value

legs.target: the ONE ad-hoc invocation of opal-assets-mdpf-portal-publisher, in the event shape its own scheduler sends
legs.proof_required: C4: StatusCode 200, no FunctionError, a response naming the leaves it served

legs.target: the BEFORE/AFTER comparison of every served leaf under opal-data-portal-v2 platinum/mdpf/{scope}/
legs.proof_required: C5: DELTA=0 on every data-bearing value with the leaf denominator printed (only _provenance.written_at and _manifests/ may differ), or the same-session rollback recorded and its re-read matching BEFORE
TF apply (0 destroy) + 0-diff replan + deployed source_code_hash matches uploaded sha + verify-on-served
